about_the_game:
Viet Quoc Truyen Ky is a classic-style MMORPG featuring familiar elements such as monster hunting, level grinding, item collection, and free item trading between players.

The game's setting is primarily inspired by Vietnam's late feudal period, a time when secret societies and captivating legends were prevalent.

However, the game is not confined to a specific era but instead blends multiple historical periods with unique Vietnamese mythology and folklore.

Gameplay Details

Leveling Up

Like classic RPGs, you will hunt monsters to level up. Each time you level up, you become stronger through potential points, can equip better gear, and learn new skills.

Items and Equipment

Items in the game are primarily obtained by looting monsters, and the stats of equipment when dropped are random. The drop rate is higher when you hunt monsters with a similar level.

Factions

At level 10, you can join one of 6 factions, each with its own unique skill system and characteristics.

Monsters

The game features many types of monsters spread across different areas. Monsters in higher-level regions are stronger and drop better loot. Each area also has a major boss that requires team coordination to defeat, but the rewards are more attractive.

Maps

The game world includes 3 safe towns and many areas to level up. Each map has its own distinctive landscape. In addition to the main maps, there are also hidden and fantasy maps related to folklore stories.

Freedom Like The Old Days

The game features a classic and free playstyle, not confined to quests and daily activities. You can explore based on your personal preferences or venture with friends and guilds to level up and hunt bosses.

short_description: Viet Quoc Truyen Ky is an online role-playing game (MMORPG) with a strong classic, retro style, featuring familiar elements such as monster hunting, level grinding, item looting, and free item trading between players. The game is deeply intertwined with captivating legends and rich folklore.
